records.real_world_identity_notes: The AC Kunos base-game content 'ks_lamborghini_miura_sv' depicts the Lamborghini Miura P400 SV, the final and most powerful Miura variant (1971-1973, approximately 148-150 units). This is the same real car already curated under record_id 'lamborghini-miura-sv' from an AMS2 guided drive, whose shorter display name omits the 'P400' engine-type prefix but names the identical production car. 'P400' identifies the mid-transverse 4-litre V12 layout shared across the whole Miura line; 'SV' (SuperVeloce) is the final-series trim. No conflicting specification, chassis, or livery evidence was found that would separate the AC content from the already-curated real car.
